about.description: Stobox provides tokenized access to private credit and structured finance products, connecting institutional lenders with decentralized liquidity. It enables securitization of off-chain credit through on-chain smart contracts.
about.registryInfo: Stobox Technologies Inc. (Estonia, registered ICO/STO advisor). Provides white-label tokenization SaaS for security-token issuance, KYC/AML compliance, and trading-venue setup. STBU governance/utility token live on multiple DEXs.

fees.revenueNotes: Stobox earns one-time platform-setup fees, annual SaaS subscription fees from issuers, and a small per-transaction transfer fee on the secondary venue. STBU is used for fee discounts and governance.
